reasons: The plugin enquiry form is the system of record: it captures the guest band, event type, dietary needs, consent text and attribution (src/lib/attribution-schema.ts, CateringLead) that the quote workflow and the closed loop depend on. A Google-hosted form would split leads into a second inbox with no gclid in our database.

Lead form assets must serve with conversion-focused bidding and a lead form conversion goal (Google Ads Help, https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/9423234, retrieved 2026-10-02), which is the wrong bidding phase for a new account with no conversion history.

Delivery needs a webhook, Zapier or manual CSV (the same page lists CSV for 30 days, email, API for 60 days, webhook, Zapier). That is another integration to build and secure before it earns anything.
Lead forms need a privacy policy link and the Spam Act consent wording to be right inside Google's form. We cannot test that wording on our own page first.
Availability for an Australian account in this vertical is unverified: [CONFIRM: lead form assets are offered to this account].
lead_form.revisit_when: The site form is converting and 60 days of search-terms data exist. Test a lead form on one ad group only, as an experiment, and compare cost per qualified (won) lead, not cost per form.
